# 从颈部疼痛查询看ChatGPT主题覆盖与扇出

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-10-26 18:43（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2114669360207831250
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

你们大多数人在试图“排进 ChatGPT”时，都像是在随手扔飞镖，从来没有拆解过实际发生了什么。

下面这个例子，也解释了为什么我总说：想出现在 ChatGPT 中，要关注主题覆盖，而不是关键词。

例子：

1. 我刚刚让 ChatGPT 帮我解决颈部疼痛。

它追问了几个问题，例如脖子的哪一侧，从而获得更多上下文。随后，ChatGPT 做了两轮查询扇出。

2. 它使用的网页搜索查询是：

“颈部上斜方肌拉伸 物理治疗 示意图”

这个查询发给了 Bing、Google 以及其他搜索相关合作方。

各个结果彼此比较、评分，最后 ChatGPT 给出了一个答案，并附上了几处引用。

3. 当你在 Google 中搜索这个查询时，会得到针对我这个问题的具体解决方法。

我看到的部分页面结果如下：

- 如何进行上斜方肌拉伸。
- 颈部拉伸运动。
- 颈部向侧面拉伸，也就是上斜方肌拉伸。
- 头部侧倾，上斜方肌拉伸。

看到了吗？它没有搜索“如何解决颈部疼痛”，而是聚焦于具体语境和结果。

如果你想获得排名和引用，就要以主题覆盖为目标，这会让你更有机会获得点击。

我正在开发一个工具，把这项能力集成进 Roborank，可能也会提供一个免费的 Chrome 扩展。

## 英文原文

Most of you are throwing darts trying to "rank in ChatGPT" without ever dissecting what happens.

Here's an example and reason and why I always say to focus on Topical Coverage —instead of Keywords— to show up in ChatGPT

Example:

1. I just asked chatGPT to help me fix my neck pain.

It asked me a few follow up questions (what side of the neck, which provided more context) , and then ChatGPT did two rounds of query fan out.
 
2. The web search it used:

"neck upper trapezius stretch physical therapy illustration"

That query went to bing, Google, and other search-related partners.

The responses were all scored against each other, and ChatGPT offered a final answer that also also brought a few citations.

3. When you do that query search on Google, it brings a specific solution to my problem. 

These are some of the page results I could see:

- How to Perform the Upper Trapezius Stretch
- THE NECK STRETCHING EXERCISES
- Neck Strectch to the Side (Upper trap stretch)
- Head Tilt (Upper Trapezius Stretch)

See how it didn't look for "How to fix neck pain", but instead focused on specific context and results. 

If you wanted to rank and get cited you'd have to aim at topical coverage, which will give you better chances or earning the click. 

I'm working on a tool to integrate this on roborank, probably will offer a free chrome extension as well.
